summary: Full backend + frontend test of the React+FastAPI Advisor on Call founder dashboard. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (401 on all protected routes w/o or with bad token, /me + one-time 3-sample seeding, priorities CRUD/reorder/status/closed list/reopen/delete, validation 422s, cross-user isolation, voice-token signedUrl wss + dynamicVariables + priorityIds, calls save/list newest-first). Frontend (Clerk ticket sign-in): landing CTAs, signed-out redirect to /sign-in, onboarding of second user -> dashboard with 3 samples, add/edit/done/reopen/dismiss/delete priority, grip drag reorder persists after reload, live ElevenLabs call (Live indicator, timer, mute note, End -> row in Recent calls and Calls page), Connections (2 items, 'Coming with the team pipeline', no buttons), Settings save updates greeting, refresh keeps session, sign-out. One real bug: mobile 390px dashboard overflows horizontally (call tile 792px wide).

minor.issue: Does N sequential update_one calls and silently ignores unknown/foreign ids (returns ok). Fine functionally; consider bulk_write.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px document scrollWidth=816; the grid column resolves to 792px so the Start call tile and priority board are cut off on the right (call tile copy, 'Call now' button and priority actions off-screen). Root cause: '@media (max-width:960px){.dash-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}' - 1fr has an auto (min-content) minimum, and the call tile's content (Rive canvas 263px + copy) forces it wider. Fix: use 'grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr)' in the media query and/or 'min-width:0' on .call-tile; verify .op-face canvas doesn't exceed its orb. Other pages (/call,/calls,/connections,/settings) are 390px wide and fine.

issues: Deadline uses native browser datetime-local picker (mm/dd/yyyy --:--) rather than a shadcn Calendar/Popover; inconsistent with the rest of the styled UI
Chip label renders 'First Customers' (title case) while spec says 'First customers'
Signing out from the app lands on /sign-in (guard redirect) instead of the landing page; consider afterSignOutUrl='/'

action_items: Fix mobile dashboard horizontal overflow: .dash-grid mobile columns minmax(0,1fr) + min-width:0 on grid children / .call-tile
Optional: replace native datetime-local deadline input with shadcn Calendar picker
Optional: set Clerk afterSignOutUrl to '/' so sign-out shows the landing page
critical_code_review_comments: useVoiceCall: if the user navigates away during 'connecting' (before startSession resolves), the unmount cleanup runs with conv.current=null, so the session started afterwards is never ended (orphan live call/mic). Track an 'unmounted' ref and end the session when startSession resolves after unmount.
useVoiceCall: getUserMedia stream acquired as a permission probe is never stopped (tracks keep the mic indicator on until GC); stop its tracks after the check.
PriorityBoard persistOrder fires on every drag end even when order unchanged; harmless but extra requests.
backend reorder endpoint: no validation that ids are open priorities; closed items in payload get a rank silently.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_advisor_api.py -> renamed legacy_express_test_advisor_api.py.bak (it targeted the old Express app and would fail)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows pass; mobile dashboard layout overflow)

Second user was onboarded during UI test and then RESET (profile+priorities deleted) so it is again not onboarded. Note connection-indicator text is CSS-uppercased ('LIVE'/'OFFLINE') in inner_text. Fake mic: grant microphone permission + override getUserMedia with an oscillator stream via add_init_script; real ElevenLabs session connects. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_founder_api.py.
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow: CSS grid track '1fr' = minmax(auto,1fr); auto min equals the min-content width of .call-tile, which is wide due to flex children (Operator canvas + copy) so the single column grows to 792px > viewport. minmax(0,1fr) lets the track shrink to the container.
